title: Kiritani Haruka — The World's Best Smile〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Beyond The Dream of That Day

rows.Line: Shopping Mall

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori and the others said to meet... Oh, I think it's here.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I got here sooner than expected...
But I'm sure they'll arrive early too, so I'll just wait...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
Sis...
Where are you...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(That girl's all alone...
Is she lost?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hello.
Is everything okay? Are you lost?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Oh, um...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I won't hurt you.
So, would you mind telling me what happened? You can take your time.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
O-Okay...
So, I came here with my sis to go to the bookstore.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: But I saw this shop with really cute plushies... Then, when I went to go see them, she disappeared.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Did she keep walking without realizing that her little sister wasn't following her...?)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Does your sister have a phone on her? If you know her number, I could try calling her...

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line:
No, she doesn't...
But she did tell me to come here if I ever did get lost.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(I think she's around five...
I wonder how old her sister is.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Also, she promised to wait here if anything happened, so I probably shouldn't take her to mall security...)

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: When's Sis gonna come...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Don't worry.
I'm sure your sister will come very soon. So, until she does, I'll stay here with you.

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Y-You will...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yes. My name's Haruka.
Can you tell me yours...?

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: Nozomi...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nozomi? Got it. Alright, Nozomi, why don't I teach you some special magic words?

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Magic words...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes. First, you place your index fingers on your cheeks, and then you...do a fist pump!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And the magic words for this are, “Poke your cheeks and pose and smile!”

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Wow, that sounds like some kind of spell.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Would you like to try it with me, Nozomi? Here we go.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Poke your cheeks and pose and smile♪

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Poke your cheeks...and pose and... Smile!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Nice! That was a wonderful smile.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka, where did you learn these magic words?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Well...
Nozomi! Where are you?!

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Oh, it's Sis!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank goodness. Your sister came looking for you.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: Yeah! Thanks for hanging out with me, Haruka.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line: Nozomi! Why'd you disappear like that?! You almost made my heart stop!

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: I'm sorry...

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line: Oh dear...were you okay? You must've been so lonely...

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line:
Yeah, a little...
But I got to hang out with Haruka, and she even taught me some fun magic words!

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line: Thank you so much for watching my little sister.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
You're welcome.
I'm glad your sister came looking for you like you said, Nozomi. But promise not to get lost again, okay?

rows.Speaker: Nozomi
rows.Line: I promise! Thanks for hanging out with me, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Of course, take care.

rows.Speaker: Nozomi's Sister
rows.Line:
Again, I can't thank you enough!
Wait a second...? Haruka...? As in...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, Haruka!
You're here early!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Sorry about the wait. Unfortunately, Minori and I had to help a certain someone here after we spotted her walking in the wrong direction.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Which saved me from getting lost. However, we ended up making you wait, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
Actually, that's funny... While I waited, I also had the opportunity to lend somebody a hand.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Lend somebody a hand?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Anyway, now that we're all here, shall we?
